div.div:
Constraints and indexes (SQLite with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON)
• listings: CHECK base_price > 0 · CHECK min_nights ≥ 1 AND max_nights ≥ min_nights · CHECK discounts BETWEEN 0 AND 90 · INDEX city, category, host_id
• bookings: CHECK check_out > check_in · CHECK status IN ('confirmed','cancelled') · INDEX (listing_id, check_in, check_out), guest_id
• blocked_dates: CHECK end_date > start_date
• reviews: UNIQUE booking_id (one review per stay) · CHECK rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5
• message_templates: CHECK trigger IN ('on_confirm','day_before_checkin','on_checkout')
• users.email UNIQUE · amenities.name UNIQUE
• Composite PKs on listing_amenities and wishlist_items
• Every FK is ON DELETE CASCADE except messages.template_id (SET NULL)
• Money is whole rupees (INTEGER). Bookings store a price snapshot. Ratings are not stored: AVG(rating) per listing is computed in a subquery.
